question: Do the frozen expected SHA-256 hashes for three primary filing documents match the corresponding primary document extracted from the original SEC daily Feed submission for the filing date, while today's public Archives file has a different hash?

source.original_feed_pattern: YYYYMMDD.nc.tar.gz, where YYYYMMDD is the filing date

procedure.downloads: Only the three exact filing-day Feed archives and current primary document URLs; no annual or quarterly full SEC archive downloads

hypotheses.H1: At least one frozen expected hash equals the primary document bytes (allowing only outer SEC <TEXT> wrapper line-break variants) extracted from the exact original daily Feed submission, while current public Archives bytes differ.
hypotheses.H0: None of the three frozen expected hashes matches the original Feed primary body variants.

decision_rules.FROZEN_HASH_MATCHES_ORIGINAL_FEED_BODY_C: This sample supports historical source-vintage drift for that exact accession; it does not authorize automatic hash replacement or unblocking Q220. Any source correction requires a separately reviewed patch and expanded pre-registered replication.
decision_rules.FROZEN_HASH_MATCHES_NEITHER_OBSERVED_BOD: Expected-hash provenance or historical extraction remains unresolved; keep Q220 blocked.
decision_rules.FEED_NOT_FOUND_OR_BOUNDS_EXCEEDED: Keep Q220 blocked; the probe is incomplete and no conclusion is allowed.

prohibitions: Do not rewrite the frozen population receipt expected hashes.
Do not allow this diagnostic to make Q220 gate_positive, source_complete, scientific_evidence, or performance_authorization true.
Do not infer absence of later-day correction from only the filing-day Feed.
Do not download yearly archives or expand beyond the three exact sample accessions.
Do not run performance tests, select holdout, rank, tune, promote, or execute live.
